title: Chunkbot
description: A Minecraft plugin that spawns a chunk-loading bot at your location to keep nearby areas active even when no players are present.
body:
ChunkBot is a Minecraft plugin designed to facilitate chunk loading around a player by spawning a static or mobile bot at the player's exact location.

⚙️ Key Features

Instant Bot Spawning A single command spawns a bot exactly at your current position. Example: /chunkbot spawn

Automatic Chunk Loading The bot acts as a connected player:

It keeps the chunks around it loaded.

It prevents chunks from unloading even when no players are nearby.

Perfect for automatic farms, redstone contraptions, and technical servers.

Customizable Loading Radius Configurable via the config.yml file:

Radius in chunks (e.g., 5, 10, 20...).

Performance mode (to reduce server load).

Visible or Invisible Bots Two modes available:

👤 Visible: Appears as a "fake player."

👻 Invisible: Discrete loading without a visual presence.

Bot Teleportation Move the bot to specific coordinates or to a player:

/chunkbot tp <x> <y> <z>

/chunkbot tp <player>

Bot Removal To prevent server lag or clutter:

/chunkbot remove
